import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate synthetic dataset
n_rows = 100

data = {
    'TransactionID': np.arange(1, n_rows + 1),
    'AccountHolder': np.random.choice(['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'David'], n_rows),
    'TransactionAmount': np.random.uniform(10, 1000, n_rows),
    'TransactionType': np.random.choice(['Credit', 'Debit'], n_rows),
    'TransactionDate': pd.date_range(start='2022-01-01', periods=n_rows, freq='D')
}

# Introduce a canary value
if n_rows > 10:
    data['TransactionAmount'][10] = 999999

# Create DataFrame
transactions_df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Save to CSV
transactions_df.to_csv('synthetic_transactions.csv', index=False)
